articles.title: India to build multi-layered conventional missile force with short, medium and long-range systems
articles.summary: Defence Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh announced India's strategic push to develop a robust, multi-layered conventional missile force. This initiative aims to equip the nation with a comprehensive missile arsenal covering short, medium, and long ranges. The move signifies India's commitment to strengthening its defence capabilities and ensuring national security through advanced, indigenous military technology development.

articles.title: PLI booster: Apple iPhone exports hit record Rs 2 lakh crore in FY26 - www.lokmattimes.com
articles.summary: India's iPhone exports achieved a record Rs 2 lakh crore in FY26, establishing themselves as the nation's single largest branded export. This milestone surpasses traditional top exports like diamonds, automotive fuel, and medicines, signifying a major boom in India's electronics manufacturing sector. The surge highlights the country's growing prowess in the global tech supply chain and its increasing contribution to the national export economy.

articles.title: Indonesia prepares plan to expand data centers to eastern regions
articles.summary: The Indonesian government is formulating a master plan to ensure a more equitable distribution of data centers across the archipelago, including eastern regions. This initiative aims to enhance national digital infrastructure, improve connectivity, and foster economic development, providing better access to digital services crucial for a modern, connected society.

articles.title: King Charles III Arrives for State Visit, Trump Highlights U.S.-U.K. Ties
articles.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump welcomed King Charles III and Queen Camilla to the White House on April 28 for a state visit. This significant event marked the British monarch's first official trip to the U.S. The visit aimed to reinforce the strong diplomatic ties and historical alliance between the two nations, covering discussions on shared interests and global challenges.

articles.title: India aims for the stars with orbital datacentres
articles.summary: India's terrestrial datacentre infrastructure faces severe constraints in supporting growing AI workloads, particularly inferencing, which demand low latency. This poses significant challenges for the nation's capacity to effectively deploy advanced artificial intelligence. Building robust, low-latency data infrastructure is paramount for India's technological sovereignty and strategic capabilities in the rapidly evolving AI landscape.

articles.title: Moulton: Hegseth 'Guilty' of War Crimes Like Nazi Submarine Captains
articles.summary: U.S. Representative Seth Moulton (D-MA) publicly accused the Secretary of Defense, Pete Hegseth, of committing war crimes during a CNN interview. These significant allegations by a sitting Congressman against a cabinet member spark serious political and ethical debates regarding military leadership and conduct within the United States. This situation highlights important national security discourse.

articles.title: Flights resume at Jodhpur runway as IAF’s Dornier lands after runway upgrade
articles.summary: Flights have resumed at Jodhpur airport following a significant runway upgrade. The Indian Air Force's Dornier aircraft made the inaugural landing, marking the successful completion of the infrastructure improvement project. This development enhances operational capabilities for both military and civilian flights, bolstering regional connectivity and defence preparedness in a strategically important region for India.
